audience: sales teams that write and track proposals in Better Proposals

useCases.title: Find proposals opened but not signed yet
useCases.text: List the proposals in the opened state. Open one proposal to see its company, totals and links.

useCases.title: Review signed proposals and the proposal count
useCases.text: List the signed proposals and read one of them for its totals. Count all proposals in the account.

useCases.title: Check templates and merge tags before drafting
useCases.text: List the templates and open one to see its sections. List the custom merge tags you can use in a new proposal.

useCases.title: Draft a proposal from a template for a client
useCases.text: Pick a company and a template. Create a proposal from them. The reply holds the view, preview and editor links.

useCases.title: Change the settings of a proposal
useCases.text: Read the proposal first. Then change the settings you pass. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Recipients cannot be changed here.
